title: Ansel and the Hymn
author: Wendell Coldharbour
blurb: Isandro Blackwood, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
